title: BKT Critical Exponents vs Helium-4 Films

Kc_prediction.universality_note: K_c = 2/π is universal for BKT. Pe framework inherits this.
Kc_prediction.pe_specific: y_K exponent (approach rate) is Pe-specific, not K_c itself.

beta_structure.note: Standard BKT has marginally stable K_c (essential singularity). Pe framework has linearly stable K_c for y_K < 0. The stability structure matches qualitatively: negative y_K = transition present, positive y_K = transition absent. The QUANTITATIVE difference (essential vs linear singularity) is a prediction of the Pe framework.

vortex_core_comparison.interpretation: If y_K=-3.4 maps to helium (b≈1.5), the scale factor is ~0.44. OU class (y_K=-0.5) would predict b≈0.22 — a system with very weak vortex core energy (barely bound vortex pairs). Population class (y_K=+1.5) predicts the transition is ABSENT (y_K > 0 means K flows away from K_c).

verdict: BKT BRIDGE PARTIALLY CROSSED — majority of tests pass.
